Submission Description: (doc-less) Motion to Intervene of Consumers Energy Company under ER26-3650-000.

Submission Date:        9/18/2026 1:33:40 PM

Filed Date:             9/18/2026 1:33:40 PM

Dockets
-------
ER26-3650-000        Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): 2026-08-28_Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads submitted on 8/28/2026 4:41:03 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Consumers Energy Company                 rachael.moore@cmsenergy.com              fercfilings@cmsenergy.com               

Basis for Intervening:
Consumers Energy Company (“Consumers Energy”) is a public utility serving over 1.9 million residential, commercial, and industrial customers in the Lower Peninsula of the State of Michigan.  Being a transmission dependent utility, Consumers Energy acquires network integrated transmission service from the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”) under its Open Access Transmission, Energy and Operating Reserve Markets Tariff (“Tariff”).  Accordingly, Consumers Energy has a direct and substantial interest in the changes to the MISO Tariff proposed in the above captioned docket, and its interest would not be adequately represented by any other party.  Hence, Consumers Energy’s participation is necessary, in the public interest and appropriate to the administration of the Federal Power Act.
